independence_basis: Independent reviewer did not author the v3 candidate or generator. Recomputed candidate and source SHA-256 values, compared all carried rows with the pinned approved v4 datasets, checked v2 equality, completeness, PK/FK order and approval boundaries, and ran the focused generator tests.
scope: Exact insert-only transfer of 44 approved v4 source rows (one demographic profile, one appearance profile, 42 universal categories) with separate source file/SHA-256/row-ID refs, plus the 85 unchanged v2 target inserts; empty existing_dependencies, complete profile/category membership, unique primary keys and foreign-key import order.
exclusions: No import mapping approval, PostgreSQL write or live 129-key collision check, rollback probe, import/readback approval, runtime binding, historical row update, v4 world-revision import, party migration or release activation.
